items.title: Omikuji
items.task: If you draw a fortune slip, read it. If it is bad luck, look how people tie them.

items.title: Ema
items.task: Find the wooden wish plaques. What are people asking for?

items.title: Goshuin
items.task: Find the stamp-and-brush office if it is open. This is a record, not a sticker shop.

items.title: Purification basin
items.task: Watch the water pavilion. Hands, then mouth, then the ladle handle.
items.notes: Live sample discovery temizu already exists. This is the Kyoto script twin. Do not promote both.

items.title: Stone Jizo
items.task: Find a small stone figure in a bib or hat. A roadside guardian.
